messages:
Aisha Patel: paging — Major: Hosted API region us-west-2 experiencing sustained 5xx + tail latency for ~18m. Multiple customers reporting timeouts. I’m taking lead. incident-bot, can you confirm alerts and start incident channel?

incident-bot: ALERT: Major incident created (INC-2026-112). Severity: P1. Triggers: 5xx_rate > 5% AND p95_latency > 1.2s for 15m. Paging: @oncall-eng (Tom Reynolds). Log link: https://logs.internal/redwood/INC-2026-112

Tom Reynolds: on it. joining call in 2m. first step: fail open to cached variants and scale up gorouters.

Marina Gomez: I’m on network checks — no obvious LB config drift. K8s nodes autoscaled normally. Seeing a spike in KV cache misses. correlating with model-change rollout?

Kenji Saito: Reverting canary model bundle (m-ops/variant-2026-09) to previous helps. Running rollback now. 

Tom Reynolds: rollback done. rolling restart of serving pods in us-west-2. mitigation: temporarily disable aggressive batching for this region.

Aisha Patel: customer impact: at least 4 enterprise customers reported >30s TTF first token and some 100% errors. Need to track for SLA credit. Priya can you start impact assessment and extract affected invoice periods?

Priya Rao: on it. Pulling request logs + billing events, will list customers with error windows. Tentative list so far: AcmeCorp, Fontify, Studyly. I’ll attach time windows and estimated token loss.

Tom Reynolds: latency back to baseline after rollback + restart. system metrics: p95 down to 220ms, 5xx <0.5% now. Keeping mitigations for 10m to confirm.

Aisha Patel: great. Thanks everyone. ACTIONS: (1) Postmortem owner & meeting (2) Billing/SLA credit calc (3) Root cause investigative tasks. Assigning: Marina for RCA, Tom for rollback runbook, Priya for billing, Kenji for model-release safeguards.

Marina Gomez: I’ll draft postmortem. propose meeting tomorrow 10am PT. ETA for initial RCA draft: EOD today.

Priya Rao: started SLA_CREDIT_REQUEST ticket: SLA-8791. Draft notes: customers impacted + minutes of downtime per customer + lost token estimate. Need finance approval for credit amounts. @BillingBot can you create pre-filled credit memos when I drop estimated amounts?

BillingBot: I can generate credit memos. Attach SLA-8791 payload with customer IDs and amounts in cents as a CSV. Template: 
```
customer_id,invoice_period,start_ts,end_ts,claimed_credit_cents,reason
acme-123,2026-03,1913123400,1913123800,125000,API downtime P1
```

Priya Rao: attaching preliminary CSV to ticket. Pls generate memos for accounting review.

Tom Reynolds: filed action item: runbook gap — we don’t auto-detect model bundle KV cache miss patterns. Add to backlog with priority high. Steps to reproduce added to INC-2026-112.

Aisha Patel: Postmortem scheduling: Marina, pls schedule doc + review board. Invite SRE, Runtime, Product, Finance. Note required artifacts: timeline, impact table, mitigations, action owner+ETA.

Marina Gomez: calendar invite sent for tomorrow 10am PT. Postmortem doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/postmortems/INC-2026-112 (draft).

Priya Rao: Finance tagging: @Tom, @Aisha — need approval flow. Once memos are generated, finance will need signoff. For large customers (AcmeCorp), require Director-level approval. Estimated total credit ~ $1,250. Will break down per-customer.

Tom Reynolds: ACK. I’ll review the memos and confirm allowance for expedited credit. Note: AcmeCorp SLA clause 4.2 applies (pro-rated token refund).

Aisha Patel: keep this thread for SLA billing follow-up. Please update SLA-8791 with final confirmed amounts and attach memos. I’ll close the incident once PM and RCA are posted.

(90m later)

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Incident INC-2026-112 transitioned to postmortem state. Timeline and initial RCA available at doc link.

Marina Gomez: RCA draft uploaded. Root cause: canary model variant increased KV miss rate due to metadata schema mismatch; cache invalidation triggered under specific seq_len distribution, causing fetch storms. Mitigation: rollback solved symptoms. Planned fixes: schema validation in bundle loader, KV pre-warming, and metrics alert for cache miss amplification.

Priya Rao: billing CSV finalized and memos generated. Totals: AcmeCorp $900, Fontify $250, Studyly $100 (USD). SLA-8791 updated with memos attached. Requesting finance approval queue.

Tom Reynolds: added runbook PR for canary rollback pattern + automated quick-rollback toggle. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runbooks/pull/334

Aisha Patel: ACTIONS recap in thread — Marina: lead RCA (ETA EOD). Tom: runbook PR merged? ETA tomorrow morning. Priya: follow up with Finance and post memos to accounting system. Kenji: implement schema validation (ETA 2 weeks).

BillingBot: Finance approval workflow started. Queue ID: FIN-4427. Expected review SLA 3 business days. If expedited, contact @Priya Rao with justification.

Priya Rao: Requesting expedited review due to enterprise customer SLA. Filed FIN-4427 with priority: expedited. 

Aisha Patel: closing note — thanks for quick responses. Please comment on postmortem doc with any missing timeline entries. I’ll schedule a 30-min retro after the RCA is finalized. :thumbsup:

(3 days later)

Priya Rao: Finance approved memos under FIN-4427. Credits scheduled to apply on next billing run. AcmeCorp credit memo ID: CM-2026-3345.

Tom Reynolds: runbook merged and deployed small agent for auto-rollback detection. Verified in staging.

Marina Gomez: RCA final sent to leadership. Action items tracked in sprint board: RB-224 (schema validation), RB-225 (KV pre-warm), RB-226 (alerting).

Aisha Patel: this thread serves as canonical incident -> postmortem -> billing handoff. Closing the loop. If anyone needs follow-ups, reopen SLA-8791 or ping me. :white_check_mark:
